result.title: BEiTScore++: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with BEiT-3 and Conformalized Quantile Regression
result.summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important for deploying evaluation metrics in real-world settings, where both input ambiguity and domain shifts are common. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware extension of the BEiTScore image captioning metric, producing conformally calibrated confidence intervals alongside alignment scores. Our approach models predictive distributions over human judgments, enabling both accurate scoring and principled uncertainty quantification in a single forward pass. We evaluate our BEiTScore++ metric across multiple benchmarks with human-annotated ratings, showing that it preserves the ranking correlation of BEiTScore, while producing intervals whose width tracks the prediction error more closely than Monte Carlo dropout on most benchmarks. The estimated uncertainty also grows under image degradation and on out-of-domain artwork images, making BEiTScore++ a practical tool for uncertainty-aware evaluation of image-caption alignment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BEiTScore++，在 BEiTScore 图像描述评估指标上引入保形校准的分位数回归，使模型在一次前向中同时给出图文对齐分数与带校准的置信区间，并在多个基准上检验区间宽度与预测误差、图像退化和域外分布的关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把「对齐评分」与「校准不确定性」绑定，其区间宽度随误差变化的做法可供核查是否能借用于 LVR 中判断视觉证据是否充分、以及置信度驱动的停止决策；但它评估的是描述指标而非推理期 latent 状态，与主线距离较远。
